enriched_activities.desc: Lie on bed. Close eyes. Breathe slowly. Turn to left side. Pull blanket up. Remain still. Turn to right side. Adjust pillow. Continue sleeping. Stir slightly. Turn onto back. Breathe deeply. Remain asleep. Turn to left side again. Pull blanket. Continue sleeping.

Wake up. Get out of bed. Walk to bathroom. Enter bathroom. Turn on light. Turn on water heater. Use toilet. Flush toilet. Turn on sink tap. Wet hands. Pick up soap. Rub hands. Rinse hands. Turn off tap. Pick up toothbrush. Apply toothpaste. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Turn off tap. Dry face with towel.

Enter kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out eggs and milk. Close refrigerator. Take out frying pan and place on stove. Turn on stove. Crack eggs into pan and stir. Turn off stove and place eggs on plate. Open microwave. Place plate in microwave. Set timer. Start microwave. Take plate out. Close microwave. Pour milk into glass. Sit at table. Eat breakfast. Drink milk. Stand up. Wash dishes.

enriched_activities.activity: Getting dressed and preparing for work
enriched_activities.desc: Enter bedroom. Open closet. Select shirt. Select pants. Take off pajamas. Put on shirt. Put on pants. Put on socks. Put on shoes. Stand in front of mirror. Brush hair. Put on watch. Pick up bag. Check phone. Turn off fan. Walk out of bedroom.

Leave apartment. Lock door. Walk to bus stop. Wait for bus. Board bus. Pay fare. Find seat. Sit down. Look out window. Check phone. Listen to music. Get off bus. Walk to office building. Enter building. Greet receptionist. Walk to desk.

enriched_activities.activity: Working as a community program coordinator at a nonprofit
enriched_activities.desc: Sit at desk. Turn on computer. Log in. Check emails. Respond to emails. Open calendar and review schedule. Attend morning meeting and say 'Good morning' to colleagues. Discuss program plans. Make phone calls to community partners. Schedule events. Prepare documents. Print materials. Have lunch break. Go to break room. Heat lunch in microwave. Eat lunch. Return to desk. Continue working. Update database. Meet with supervisor.

Leave office. Walk to bus stop. Wait for bus. Board bus. Pay fare. Find seat. Sit down. Check phone. Listen to music. Get off bus. Walk home. Enter apartment. Lock door. Take off shoes. Walk to kitchen.

Enter kitchen. Wash hands. Open refrigerator. Take out vegetables and meat. Close refrigerator. Take out cutting board and chop vegetables. Take out pan and place on stove. Turn on stove. Add oil and meat. Stir. Add vegetables and cook. Turn off stove and serve on plate. Sit at table. Eat dinner. Drink water. Stand up. Clear table. Wash dishes.

Enter living room. Sit on sofa. Pick up remote. Turn on TV. Change channel. Adjust volume. Watch TV. Pick up phone. Check messages. Put down phone. Continue watching TV. Laugh. Change channel again. Turn off TV. Stand up. Walk to bedroom.

Walk to closet. Open closet. Take out vacuum cleaner. Unwind cord. Plug in vacuum. Turn on vacuum. Vacuum floor. Push vacuum forward. Pull vacuum backward. Move sofa. Vacuum under sofa. Move sofa back. Vacuum corners. Turn off vacuum. Unplug cord. Wind cord. Put vacuum away in closet. Close closet. Walk back to living room.

enriched_activities.activity: Using computer and phone for personal tasks
enriched_activities.desc: Enter bedroom. Sit at desk. Turn on desk lamp. Open computer. Log in. Open browser and check social media. Scroll through feed and like posts. Open email and read emails. Reply to emails. Pick up phone and check text messages. Send text message. Make phone call and say 'Hello' to friend. Talk on phone and hang up. Put down phone. Open game and play game. Close game. Turn off computer and desk lamp. Stand up. Walk to bed.

Enter bathroom. Turn on light. Turn on water heater. Use toilet. Flush toilet. Turn on sink tap. Wet hands. Pick up soap. Rub hands. Rinse hands. Turn off tap. Pick up toothbrush. Apply toothpaste. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Turn off tap. Wash face. Dry face with towel. Turn off light. Exit bathroom.

Enter bedroom. Turn off light. Lie on bed. Pull blanket up. Close eyes. Breathe slowly. Turn to left side. Adjust pillow. Remain still. Turn to right side. Breathe deeply. Continue sleeping. Turn onto back. Pull blanket. Remain asleep.
